_comment: Fetched by scripts/model_picker.py on every run (cached ~1 day). Add new abliteration-tool brand names, tag keywords, or specific repo ids here and every client (WSL, Windows) picks it up automatically, no rebuild or resync needed. 'terms' are lowercase substrings matched against a model's name and HF tags. 'known_repo_ids' force-flags a specific model regardless of tag/name matching, for cases where it doesn't self-tag accurately.
